snippet.title: Forgotten Hill Injustice - Demo Teaser
snippet.description:
After escaping from the horrors and the traps of the Museum, together with the poor souls that was held prisoners there, Mister Larson has found shelter in the only safe place in Forgotten Hill: Grandpa Larson's house.
Here they can plan their actions to start a new journey, across familiar locations and brand new places, where he will finally be able to confront Ruth and her evil companions.

Forgotten Hill Injustice is our upcoming new game, Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5306720/Forgotten_Hill_Injustice/

A free Demo is available on:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5306740/Forgotten_Hill_Injustice_Demo/
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.fmstudio.forgottenhillinjusticelite
Poki: https://poki.com/en/g/forgotten-hill-injustice-chapter-i
itch.io: https://fm-studio.itch.io/forgotten-hill-injustice-demo
Forgotten Hill Website: https://www.forgotten-hill.com/game/forgotten-hill-injustice-chapter-1/

Background Music:
"SCP-x7x (6th Floor)" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
